MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The chain quick links and magnets feel useful alongside my fasteners because they offer ways to connect, hold, or make removable attachments in DIY projects.",
    "The dial indicator feels like a plausible next tool after my caliper for checking alignment, while the quick-setting glue fills a small-repair need that my casting resin and mounting tape do not handle as conveniently."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The radiation detector and wall-mounted noise meter measure things, but I have no current use for those measurements in my hands-on repairs. The radiation detector's mixed title also leaves me uncertain what I would receive.",
    "The wire ferrules require a wiring project I do not currently have, and the door hooks serve household storage rather than the workshop tasks I am shopping for.",
    "Cotter pins fit my interests, but I already bought a large assortment. Gaffers tape could be useful, but five rolls are more than I need now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying measuring tools seems to have been taken as interest in any measuring device, even when it serves a very different task.",
    "My purchases of fastener assortments seem to have been taken as a reason to suggest more large supply kits, without enough attention to whether I already own them or have a use for them."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "A useful next purchase should add a capability to my existing tools and supplies, such as checking runout or making removable connections.",
    "Current project needs, quantities, and what I already have matter: an item can suit my repair interests without being something I would choose today."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in DIY repairs, but sometimes confused broad tool similarity with a useful addition to my current supplies."
}
